app.name: Crop Advisor
app.disclaimer: Advisory only. Every figure carries its source — check it against local extension advice before sowing.

home.title: What should I grow this season?
home.subtitle: Tell us where your field is and what season you are planning for. You will get a ranked list of crops, the reasoning behind each one, and what the numbers look like.

location.heading: Where is your field?
location.help: Pick your district, or give the exact coordinates for a sharper reading.
location.districtListUnavailable: District list unavailable. Switch to coordinates to continue.
location.geoUnsupported: This device cannot share its location. Enter the coordinates instead.
location.geoDenied: Location permission denied. Enter the coordinates or pick a district.

season.heading: About the season
season.help: These shape which crops are even considered.
season.label: Season
season.areaTooSmall: Area must be greater than zero.
season.areaTooLarge: This tool covers plots up to 100 hectares.

actions.slowHint: Satellite soil data can take a few seconds to wake up.

results.title: Best options for {district}
results.empty: No crop cleared the suitability threshold for these inputs. Try a different season or relax your constraints.
results.scoreCaveat: Suitability scores compare crops within this result only. They are not comparable across different fields or seasons.
results.warningHeading: Read this before acting on the results

crop.yieldNote: Historical district average, not a prediction for this plot
crop.priceUnavailable: Market prices were unavailable for this crop, so the revenue figures cannot be shown. The agronomic advice above still stands.
crop.risksNote: These are the risks typical for this crop in this region, not a live pest alert.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.noData: We have no soil or weather coverage for that spot yet. Try a nearby district.
errors.invalidLocation: That location could not be read. Check the coordinates or pick a district.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests just now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.upstream: A data source is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Satellite data can be slow to wake up — try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

map.aria: Map for drawing your field boundary
map.hint: Tap the map to mark each corner of your field.
map.needMore: Tap {count} more corner(s) to close the field.

indices.title: Satellite view of this field
indices.unavailable: No clear satellite image for this field recently. Cloud cover blocks the view during the monsoon, which is normal.
indices.historyTitle: Vegetation over the last two years
indices.historyHelp: What this plot has actually supported, season by season. More useful for planning than today's reading.
indices.caveat: These indices describe what is growing on the plot now. Before sowing, treat the history above as the stronger signal.

soil.heading: Have your Soil Health Card?
soil.help: No satellite can measure nitrogen, phosphorus or potassium — these come from a lab. If your Soil Health Card is to hand, entering them makes the recommendation sharper.
soil.partialOk: Enter whichever values you have — one is better than none.
soil.tooHigh: That looks too high (max {max}). Check the decimal point.
